categories.main_business_segments: Open House Group operates five main business segments: Detached Housing (including brokerage, development, and construction), Condominium Business, Income Property Business, Other (including US real estate and financial services), and Pressance Corporation (focused on investment and family condominiums). Each segment is supported by a network of subsidiaries and covers a broad range of real estate-related activities from development to sales and management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes an integrated production and sales model, particularly in detached housing, where land acquisition, design, construction, and sales are managed internally for efficiency and cost control. Construction emphasizes maximizing limited urban land, often with three-story homes, and cost management in condominium development by minimizing model rooms and promotional expenses. The group also leverages data-driven land sourcing, modular construction techniques, and internalized brokerage to optimize supply and responsiveness to market needs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include urban families and working couples seeking affordable new homes in city centers, single and dual-income households for compact condominiums, individual and corporate investors for income properties, and affluent Japanese clients for US real estate investments. The company’s end markets are primarily residential buyers in major metropolitan areas and investors seeking stable real estate assets.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Japan’s major metropolitan areas: Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama, Chiba, Aichi (Nagoya), Osaka, Hyogo, Fukuoka, and Gunma, with expanding presence in Kansai and Fukuoka. Internationally, the group is active in the US (California and Texas) for real estate sales and management, and also has a presence in Shanghai, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Open House Group is vertically integrated, operating across the real estate supply chain from upstream land acquisition and development, through midstream construction and project management, to downstream sales, brokerage, and property management. The group also provides financial and after-sales services, positioning itself as a comprehensive real estate solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the core detached housing business, expanding into new geographic markets (notably Kansai), growing the condominium and income property segments, and leveraging synergies from recent M&A (notably Pressance and Meldia). The group emphasizes governance, compliance, customer satisfaction, talent acquisition, and sustainability, with a focus on decarbonization and diversity. While there is no traditional R&D, investments are made in digital transformation, sustainability, and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of newly built detached homes, condominiums, and income properties, as well as brokerage commissions, construction contracting, property management fees, and financial services. Additional revenue streams include rental income, US real estate consulting, and brand licensing within the group.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors are large Japanese real estate developers and integrated housing companies with strong land acquisition and brand power. Open House Group positions itself as an independent, rapidly growing, and highly integrated player, with a scale approaching that of the largest industry incumbents. The company differentiates through its urban focus, cost efficiency, and aggressive M&A strategy.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending September 2025, consolidated revenue reached ¥1,336.5 billion, with operating profit of ¥145.9 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of ¥100.7 billion. The company has demonstrated consistent growth in revenue and profit over the past five years, with a workforce of 6,620 employees. The balance sheet shows total assets of ¥1.41 trillion and a solid equity ratio of 38.1%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Open House Group’s value proposition centers on delivering affordable, high-quality urban housing through an integrated, efficient business model. The company emphasizes speed, cost competitiveness, and the ability to meet diverse customer needs in prime locations. Its unique strengths include internalized land sourcing, design, construction, and sales, as well as a broad product lineup and strong after-sales support, all underpinned by a commitment to customer-centricity and sustainability.
